name: Vidyadhan Scholarship Program (Sarojini Damodaran Foundation) - incl. Vidyadhan Mathura Scholarship for Women in STEM 2026-27

rules.value: main programme selects students after class 10 (state-wise 11th/plus-1 programmes, all closed for 2026); continued through degree if performance is good
rules.quote: The students are selected after completion of 10th grade /SSLC through a rigorous selection process including test and interview.

Kerala, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Odisha, New Delhi, Ladhak, Bihar, Jharkhand, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Chandigarh, West Bengal, Meghalaya and Rajasthan.
Female students from Mathura District, Uttar Pradesh, pursuing STEM courses such as MBBS, Engineering, BSc, or other STEM programs are eligible to apply.
Applicants must have secured a minimum of 70% marks in Class 12 (60% for students with disabilities)
have gained admission to the first year of a degree or professional program in the Academic Year 2026–27

rules.value: Mathura district, Uttar Pradesh (class XII from Mathura school or studying at Mathura institution)
rules.quote: have either completed Class XII from a school in Mathura District or be currently studying at an institution located there.
The annual family income must be less than ₹3 Lakhs.

amount.text: Graduation: Rs 10,000 to Rs 75,000 per year depending on state/course; Mathura STEM: Rs 15,000 to Rs 75,000 per year till course completion
amount.quote: The scholarship amount for graduation courses varies from Rs 10,000 to Rs 75,000 per year depending on the state, course, duration etc.

documents.name: Income certificate from competent authority
documents.quote: Income Certificate   (from a competent authority; ration card not accepted.)

deadline.text: Mathura Women in STEM: application last date 31 October 2026; all state 11th-standard programmes for 2026 closed
